description: This file defines common structures, function pointer types, and macros for the COSA API layer in a C-based project, including object base structures, context link objects, and list management functions.

classes.name: COSA_BASE_OBJECT
classes.description: Base object structure containing Oid, context handle, and function pointers for create, remove, and initialize operations.

classes.name: COSA_CONTEXT_LINK_OBJECT
classes.description: Structure representing a context link in writable tables, including linkage, context, parent table, instance number, and flags.

methods.name: CosaSListPushEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Pushes a context link object into a list based on its instance number.

methods.name: CosaSListGetEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Retrieves a context link object from a list by its instance number.
